name: Briar Skipper
lore: A woodland hare from Whispering Grove, collecting acorns that refuse to stay on the ground. Kick a travelling acorn into a larger blast, then vault away across your own leaf trail.

primary.name: Acorn Hop
primary.description: A visibly bouncing acorn bursts on each ground contact. An enemy takes damage at most once per acorn. Walls stop it.

secondary.name: Updraft Kick
secondary.description: A close kick knocks foes back. Your airborne acorns within 145 become larger blasts, gain 8 damage and turn toward your aim. They cannot hit a previously hit enemy again.

special.name: Canopy Crossing
special.description: Leap over a 0.65s arc, dropping three delayed acorns along the route. Each foe takes at most one 44-damage blast and a 1.5s slow. Flight is not invulnerable; walls stop the route.

passive: Woodland Footwork: After Canopy Crossing lands, gain 15% damage reduction for 1.5s.

technique.name: Far-Flung Acorns
technique.description: Reach 520 instead of 390, but damage falls from 19 to 14.

final_technique.name: Falling Chestnuts
final_technique.description: Replace the kick and acorn upgrade with three bouncing chestnuts in a fan, 14 damage each. 7s cooldown.

attack.name: Falling Chestnuts
attack.description: Three bouncing chestnuts in a fan. Each enemy is hit once per chestnut. No knockback or acorn enhancement.
